consent.title: Your information stays with you
consent.intro: Before you add your details, here is how GovNavAI looks after them:
consent.point1: Your profile is saved only on this phone, not on our servers.
consent.point2: A photo of your NIC or bill is read once and then deleted. We never keep it.
consent.point3: Details are sent only when you ask us to fill a form, and are not stored.
consent.point4: You can delete everything at any time with "Delete my data".
consent.law: Personal Data Protection Act, No. 9 of 2022
